Era, place, activity, outfit, pose and camera follow SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; the Framing in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

ERA: set this scene in the real world around 1996, when her Pokémon first appeared. Clothing, hair, devices and interiors of that time, keeping two or three recognisable parts of the chosen outfit; no smartphones or modern devices that did not exist then. Period everyday fashion only, not her armor.

SCENE (chosen):

overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: mostly posed — a paused or held moment of the selected activity
source_influence: subtle — her species shows only as one small accessory; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera, so her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.
